text:
alex_procurement: FYI AeroShip just pushed ETA on our H100 topup from 7d -> 21d. They can do a split RMA but it will be two AWBs. Options: air expedite (+$8k/unit) or accept sea with ~3wk delay. Need quick call on buffer plan. @marta_logistics

marta_logistics: Can they split so EU + US get same wave? also what HS code are they using for customs? :thinking:

vendor-liaison: Confirmed split. Two AWBs: `AWB-111222333` (sea, ETD ~21d) and `AWB-444555666` (air, ETD ~5d). Air surcharge = +$8k/unit + brokerage. Vendor suggests consolidating partial RMA at EU depot to avoid duplicate customs entries.

jia_sre: We need min 10 H100s in EU by next week for scheduled runs. If we can't get them, we'll fail the batch. Can we borrow from APAC temp-pool?

ryan_ops: Quick cost check: expedite 8 units = 8*$8k = $64k + brokerage ~10% => ~ $70k. Cross-region borrow (APAC→EU) estimated ~$12k + imaging & customs time. Tradeoff seems obvious if we need immediate capacity.

alex_procurement: I'll try to squeeze vendor on price/credits. Propose we ask for 30% off the air surcharge or a 1yr warranty extension per unit if we take the air option. Also require consolidated commercial invoice and explicit HS code to avoid surprises.

vendor-liaison: Vendor counter-offer: 15% discount on air surcharge OR 4 free loaner units (local pool) for 14 days. They also offered serialized manifest and per-serial AWB mapping.

marta_logistics: 4 loaners helps but we're still short ~6 in EU. Suggest mix: expedite 6 via air, sea for the rest. Also require vendor carry full insurance (AF=100%) until customs release and handover to our depot.

alex_procurement: Drafting contract language now: "If lead time >14 days, vendor to supply 4 loaner units per 20-unit order at no charge and provide expedite discount on air surcharges." Will run by legal.

legal_review_bot: Added to review queue. Need exact SLA thresholds and penalty math. Please provide PO numbers and expected delivery windows.

ryan_ops: Ops ask: vendor must provide per-serial RMA return labels and webhook updates to our SRE queue. If AWB splits, we need per-serial status (shipped/in-transit/arrived).

vendor-liaison: Vendor agrees to per-serial labels and webhooks. Sample webhook payload they plan to send: `{"sn":"SN12345","awb":"AWB-444555666","status":"shipped","eta":"2026-05-04"}`. Will share full schema EOD.

jia_sre: I'll add a temporary routing rule: if EU available H100s <10, route preflight jobs to US pool. Add canary to avoid blowing up production.

alex_procurement: Thanks. @marta_logistics can you prepare customs docs template + loaner acceptance SOP? I'll push vendor for the 15% now and escalate for approval on any remaining air cost.

marta_logistics: On it — prepping SOP and invoice template, will upload to #vendors-assets in 30m.

vendor-liaison: Uploaded a manifest snippet: `SN,AWB,SHIP_DATE
SN12345,AWB-444555666,2026-04-12` — if you greenlight expedite we'll hold air slot for 48h.

alex_procurement: :thumbsup: Sending revised PO request with 15% applied to air surcharge. If vendor doesn't accept, we'll escalate to execs for the $70k approval.

marta_logistics: Also request vendor to provision per-serial return label templates in PDF and include HS code `8471.80` on the invoice. That should speed customs.

vendor-liaison: Noted. We'll request HS `8471.80` and attach PDFs. Will confirm loaner pickup windows once PO update arrives.

alex_procurement: Summary: proceed with mixed plan (expedite ~6 units, accept sea for remainder) if vendor confirms 15% on air surcharge + per-serial webhooks + 4 loaners. If not, escalate. I'll update thread after vendor reply.
